scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hackathon/contracts && concurrently --kill-others -n web,api "npm run dev -w @hackathon/web" "npm run dev -w @hackathon/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @hackathon/contracts && npm run dev -w @hackathon/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hackathon/contracts && npm run build -w @hackathon/api && npm run build -w @hackathon/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hackathon/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hackathon/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
